59ffd2.title: Web surface mapping blocked by injected proxy error
59ffd2.content:
Scope: `http://172.23.0.2:5000/`.

All explicit proxy-aware HTTP(S) retrievals received a `500` HTML response titled `Caido`, with body text `Proxy encountered an unhandled error` / `Repository operation failed` / `Could not acquire a connection to the database`. This occurred for root, `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`, and `/sitemap_index.xml`; the three discovery files have identical SHA-256 `1d825545acc700425d59eeb565fd70ed5467e86fd7b1b7bba7a000001cecfaed`. Browser forced to `HTTP_PROXY` received the same `500` for `/` and `/favicon.ico`; snapshot contained no interactive elements. HTTPS test through the proxy also reported the same error page. `aidast_list_captured_requests` returned zero entries both for host and globally.

A bounded Katana run explicitly set to the injected proxy completed with only the seed root URL. A prior Katana invocation that did not honor proxy environment produced candidate paths, but it is **not proxy-confirmed evidence** and must be treated only as a lead: `/login`, `/register`, `/dashboard`, `/forgot-password`, `/merchant/login`, `/merchant/register`, `/merchant/dashboard`, `/api/ai/chat/anonymous`, `/api/v1/payments`, `/api/docs`, `/static/openapi.json`, `/internal/config.json`, and informational pages `/terms`, `/privacy`, `/compliance`, `/blog`, `/careers` plus static CSS/JS. No authentication registration/login attempted because page/forms could not be reached through required proxy.
